tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
chore(daemon): pin and provision ethos for the daemon test tier

ETHOS_VERSION + tools-ethos target, wired as a real prerequisite of
`test` so `make test`/`make check` provision ethos automatically --
matching the existing STATICCHECK_VERSION/GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION/
GOVULNCHECK_VERSION pin-once-at-top convention. CI installs the same
pinned binary via the same target and adds $(go env GOPATH)/bin to
$GITHUB_PATH before the Test step, so exec.LookPath("ethos") finds it
there exactly as it would on a developer machine.

No developer-facing manual step: the tools-ethos edge on `test` means
`make test`/`make check` are self-provisioning.
EOF
)"
tool_input.description: Commit Makefile and CI provisioning changes
